items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: when I was playing with him, he used to have a slapstick.

ctx.x: Well, at that time the drummers used to use slapsticks in the band. And Sam was, had been very sick and I guess that was something he thought would, you could bring Newt to the band, you understand? Maybe not as far as I missed the story. Yeah, no, when the band was playing he used to use that stick. Yeah. And I saw some time back, and Bebe Ridley, he used to use that stick too. Oh, he did? Yeah, when he was playing drums. I know he was playing trombone at that time. Well, Sam used that stick a long time, I'm…
Kid Thomas uses that quite a bit nowadays too. Who? Kid Thomas still has a slapstick. Oh yeah. He used it. Manuel Paul sometimes too.
Yeah, I'm quite sure he did because when I was playing with him, he used to have a slapstick.

items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now here's Israel Garman, Andrew Morgan. [INTERVIEWEE] Is he the name of Celestan Porter? Is that his name? No, not Porter. Oh, well, I don't know. No, that's not Porter.

ctx.x: I can't think of his name either.
I think I know who you mean. Yes, well, it'll come to me later on. Now here's Israel Garman, Andrew Morgan.
Is he the name of Celestan Porter? Is that his name? No, not Porter. Oh, well, I don't know. No, that's not Porter.
